title: Maru / dotfiles-v2 Boundary
summary: Ownership contract splitting filesystem paths between Maru (skills, runtime federation) and dotfiles-v2 (environment, tool settings), with must-not-write constraints.
notes: No frontmatter, no status field, no Decision/Consequences sections, no user stories. Dominant signal is binding implementation constraints ('Maru must not write:', 'dotfiles-v2 must not write ~/.claude/skills/**') plus an ownership table and a Conflict Rule -> SPEC over DOC. Competing DOC reading (short prose policy note) rejected because the doc states enforceable requirements, not explanation. Not ADR: no trade-off analysis or accepted-status marker. Doc declares itself a mirror of the workspace SSOT at _meta/rules/skills-ssot.md, so the upstream rule may outrank it in precedence.
